function.name: religion_history_get_councils

function.name: religion_history_get_schisms
function.description: Retrieves a list of major schisms in a specified religion. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
The three most significant schisms in Christian history are:

| # | Schism | Approximate dates | Key parties involved | Main theological or political issue |
|---|--------|-------------------|----------------------|-------------------------------------|
| 1 | **Great Schism (East–West Schism)** | 1054 CE | Roman Catholic Church (Western/Latin rite) vs. Eastern Orthodox Church (Greek/Byzantine rite) | Disputes over papal primacy, the Filioque clause, liturgical practices, and cultural differences |
| 2 | **Protestant Reformation** | 1517–1648 CE | Roman Catholic Church vs. emerging Protestant movements (Lutheran, Calvinist, Anglican, Anabaptist, etc.) | Issues such as indulgences, authority of Scripture vs. tradition, justification by faith, church governance, and doctrinal reforms |
| 3 | **East–West Schism (Second Great Schism)** | 1965 CE (formal declaration) | Roman Catholic Church vs. Oriental Orthodox Churches (Coptic, Armenian, Syriac, Ethiopian, Eritrean, Malankara) | Historical Christological controversies (Miaphysitism vs. Dyophysitism), ecclesiastical jurisdiction, and mutual excommunications |

These three events represent the most profound and lasting divisions within Christianity, each reshaping theology, politics, and culture across centuries.
